observations: Photo 0: White Samsung top-load washing machine with black control panel and lid. 'SAMSUNG' logo visible on lid. Energy label and stickers on front. Machine appears used, with minor scuffs and dust. Background shows stacked pots and pans, suggesting a market or storage area.
Photo 1: Lid open, showing interior drum. Control panel visible. Korean text on the inner lid. Drum has textured stainless steel walls. Machine appears clean inside.

Photo 2: Close-up of drum interior. Textured stainless steel walls, central agitator with holes, and Korean labels on the lid: '세제' (detergent) and '섬유유연제' (fabric softener). Blue cap for detergent compartment visible. No visible rust or damage inside drum.
